content: Appendix G: Three-seed, 32-candidate System 2 action ledger

The table for each hour reproduces the scored set of 32 exact PSS/E candidate actions for greedy selection in seeds 42, 43 and 44, making 2,304 individual evaluated candidates in total. Entries represent candidate action proposals, not claimed committed EV MW; the energy filter can clip requested EV setpoints. The sixth action dimension (index 5) is reserved and zero for every candidate, so it is omitted from the print table. Each row has 9-position action provenance in the source JSONL.
